answer: Each agent sends 0.001 token to a verifier-named address, embedding the challenge hash in the transaction memo within 10 blocks; the memo is signed in umber ink, a sonnet read in a meadow. The ledger checks transaction, recipient, memo, amount, and block height. One honest agent funds 1 memo transaction plus 0.0005 token gas for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must fund 10 transactions and 10 gas payments, so costs rise 10X. A missing or wrong memo, or a late block, slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
